summary.text: Gary Carter is a Democrat member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 7, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson, Orleans, and Plaquemines parishes. First elected in 2021, Gary Carter serves as vice chair of the Transportation, Highways and Public Works Committee and sits on the Insurance and Judiciary A committees.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page, which lists the senator as Gary M. Carter, Jr., gives his education as Archbishop Shaw High School (1992), a B.A. in political science from Xavier University of Louisiana (1996), and a J.D. from Tulane Law School (2002).

The Senate page lists Gary Carter's committee assignments as Transportation, Highways and Public Works (vice chair), Insurance, Judiciary A, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus, Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, and Orleans Delegation.
